Safety.title: Your home stays under <accent>your watch</accent>
Safety.body: Watch the work live from your phone. The stream is only for you and the HomeKlin monitoring team, and we ask for your consent when you book.
Safety.replayCaption: You can replay the recording, then it is deleted automatically.
Safety.checkInCaption: Your HomeKlin cleaner checks in at your address before starting work.

HowItWorks.title: How it works, in <accent>five steps</accent>
HowItWorks.lead: From booking to replaying the recording, all from your phone.

book.title: Book
book.body: Choose a service, your area and a free time slot.

pay.title: Pay
pay.body: Pay upfront. You see the full price before you pay.

checkIn.title: Cleaner checks in
checkIn.body: Your HomeKlin cleaner checks in at your address. The time and place are recorded.

watch.title: Watch live
watch.body: While the work is in progress, you can watch it from your phone.

replay.title: Replay for 7 days
replay.body: You can replay the recording for 7 days, then it is deleted.

FaqTeaser.title: Have a question? Here are the <accent>answers.</accent>

cleaner.question: Who comes to my home?
cleaner.answer: A HomeKlin cleaner. Once a cleaner is assigned, their name and photo appear in your order.

stream.question: Who can watch the live stream?
stream.answer: You, while the work is in progress, and the HomeKlin monitoring team. Other customers cannot watch it.

recordings.question: How long are recordings kept?
recordings.answer: 7 days after the work is done. After that, the recording is deleted and cannot be opened again.

payment.question: When do I pay?
payment.answer: When you book. Your order status changes as soon as the payment goes through.

CtaShell.title: Choose a free time slot in <accent>your area</accent>
CtaShell.body: You see the full price before you pay.

MarketingFooter.tagline: A home cleaning service you can watch live.

ServicesPage.title: Services

OrdersPage.title: Orders
OrdersPage.emptyBody: Your orders appear here with their status, from paid to done. While your cleaner works, you can watch the live stream from this page.

SupportPage.title: Help
SupportPage.emptyBody: You can search for answers by keyword. If the answer is not there, you can chat with an admin from this page.

JobStatusCard.privacy: Only you and the HomeKlin monitoring team can watch. The recording is kept for 7 days.

BookPage.title: Book a cleaning
BookPage.description: Check the service and the time, add your address, then book.

Booking.noWindowHint: Choose one of the free slots below.
Booking.arrivalNote: Your HomeKlin cleaner arrives within this time. Times are in Jakarta time (WIB).

Booking.addressHint: Street, house number, RT/RW, neighbourhood and a landmark if needed. 10 to 300 characters.

streamFacts.viewers: Only you and the HomeKlin monitoring team can watch it.
streamFacts.recording: The recording is kept for 7 days, then deleted.

Booking.consentLabel: I agree to the work in my home being streamed live and recorded

CleanerJobsPage.emptyBody: Jobs your agency assigns to you appear here, with the address and working hours. When you arrive, you check in from this page.

AgencySchedulePage.title: Schedule
AgencySchedulePage.emptyBody: Your agency’s availability per area appears here. Customers are only offered slots that are still free.

AgencyCleanersPage.title: Cleaners
AgencyCleanersPage.emptyBody: Your agency’s cleaners appear here, with their check-in status for today’s jobs.

AgencyOrdersPage.title: Orders
AgencyOrdersPage.emptyBody: Paid orders appear here. From this page you assign a cleaner to each order.

AgencyRecordingsPage.title: Recordings
AgencyRecordingsPage.emptyBody: Recordings of your cleaners’ jobs appear here for 7 days after the job is done, then they are deleted automatically.

AdminDashboardPage.title: Dashboard
AdminDashboardPage.emptyBody: Jobs in progress, help tickets waiting for an answer and the latest recordings appear on this page.

AdminMonitorPage.title: Live monitor

AdminTicketsPage.title: Tickets
AdminTicketsPage.emptyBody: Customer questions passed on from the Help page appear here, most urgent first.

AdminRecordingsPage.title: Recordings
AdminRecordingsPage.emptyBody: Recordings of all jobs still within the 7-day storage period appear here.

AdminServiceForm.textsHint: Fill in both languages. Customers read the text in the language they choose.

fields.idHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens, for example mattress-wash. It cannot be changed once saved.
fields.sortOrderHint: Lower numbers come first in the catalog.
fields.descriptionHint: One or two sentences, at most 300 characters.
fields.priceHint: The full price the customer pays, with no other fees. For example 85000 or 85.000.
fields.durationHint: About how long the job takes, 30 to 720 minutes.
fields.active: Active: shown in the customer catalog
fields.activeHint: Customers see an active service at once, at the price above. An inactive service stays saved for past orders.

errors.idTaken: Another service already uses this ID. Choose another one.
